verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਖਗ ਜਾਤ ਉਡਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise praat samai khag jaat udd birakh sai bahur aai baiThat birakh hee mai aai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as birds flyaway from the tree in the morning and return to the tree in the evening,

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੀਟੀ ਚੀਟਾ ਬਿਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਧਰ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਪੈਸਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਲ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cheeTee cheeTaa bil sai nikas dhar gavan kai bahurio paisat jaise bil hee mai jai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as ants and insects come out of their burrows and walk about on the ground and return back to the burrow after their wandering,

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਰ ਕੈ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਰੂਠ ਜਾਤ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਹਠ ਆਵੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lar kai larikaa rooTh jaat taat maat san bhookh laagai tiaagai haTh aavai pachhutai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a son leaves the house after an argument with his parents, and when experiences hunger gives up his obduracy and returns repentantly,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਆਸਰੋ ਤਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਕੋ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੫੪੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise gireh tiaag bhaag jaat udhaas baas aasaro takat pun girahasat ko dhai kai ||548||

en.bdb: Similarly, a man forsakes life of a householder and goes to the jungle for a hermit's life. But unable to achieve spiritual happiness and after wandering here and there returns to his family (One can realise God as a householder by keeping oneself unsullied of maya).  (548)
